catalog.name: Slack
catalog.description: Let the agent read, post and react in your Slack workspace — and wake it when someone @mentions it.
catalog.hint: Both tokens come from one Slack app. The app-level token (xapp-) opens the Socket Mode connection this sandbox listens on — no public URL, no inbound firewall hole. The bot token (xoxb-) is what the agent calls the Web API with. Ask the agent to "set yourself up in my Slack" and it writes the app manifest for you to paste.

guide.scopes: Bot: app_mentions:read, channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, groups:history, groups:read, im:history, im:read, im:write, mpim:history, reactions:read, reactions:write, users:read · App-level: connections:write
steps: Create New App → From an app manifest (ask the agent for the manifest — it fills in the scopes and events below).
Basic Information → App-Level Tokens → Generate, scope connections:write. Copy the xapp- token.
Socket Mode → toggle Enable Socket Mode on.
Install App → Install to Workspace, then copy the xoxb- Bot User OAuth Token.
Paste both tokens here, then invite the bot to a channel with /invite @yourbot.
